purpose.summary: This program (ORCGM96) is a job-management search/display component of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles screen initialization, database lookups for DB management (tbl_dbkanri), master management (tbl_mstkanri), and job management records, then formats and displays results on screen M96. It supports group/multi-facility configurations (SPA-HOSPNUM > 1).
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt software)

verdict.notes: The file is genuine COBOL source from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system (Japan Medical Association). Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) and appear garbled due to latin-1 decoding. The MCP interface is a proprietary middleware layer specific to ORCA, not standard CICS or DB2. The program follows a screen-management pattern (LINK/PUTG events, window management) typical of the ORCA platform's online transaction style. Source is truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 52676 bytes / 1279 lines.
